penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Migration tooling for Salesforce Data Cloud orgs requires per-customer configuration, environment access, and troubleshooting — not a hands-off automated delivery.

penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise Salesforce consulting engagements invariably involve scoping calls, sandbox access setup, and approval gates with client IT/security teams.

rationale: The pain is real and the buyers (Salesforce architects and enterprise DevOps teams) have genuine budget, but this is fundamentally a consulting/services play: every migration engagement requires bespoke configuration, access to customer orgs, and iterative troubleshooting that cannot be automated away. Operational autonomy scores a 3 because there is no plausible path to a self-serve, hands-off delivery model — each customer is a project. After penalties for per-customer fulfillment and synchronous sales requirements, the total collapses to 2.6, which is well below the validate threshold; this is the wrong shape of opportunity for a solo autonomous factory.
solution_plan: Not recommended for build. This would require acting as a Salesforce consultant — scoping each client's org structure, writing custom SFDX scripts per environment, and troubleshooting migration failures live. A solo non-technical operator using an AI factory cannot realistically deliver or support this autonomously. If pursued, it would be a paid consulting engagement, not a productized micro-service.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy (3 < 7 floor), buildability_with_ai (4 < 6 floor), and willingness_to_pay floor is met but moot given the autonomy failure. Drop.
